parts.html: The K-11 standard model is a straight gray kitchen in a modern style, with stone-effect fronts and simple cabinet shapes.

The stone pattern is printed on laminated fronts: the uppers are MDF, the lowers chipboard. The texture is noticeable, yet the kitchen still looks cohesive. Gray is easy to pair with light walls, wood, and metal.
All the work zones are lined up in a single 4.3-linear-meter run, and the rest of the room stays free. This works well in an apartment or a kitchen-living room.
The wall cabinets lift up on FREE FOLD Hafele mechanisms, and the doors hang on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges. The kitchen also has a cargo pull-out.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
We make the K-11 cabinets in the sizes your layout requires, and you can choose a different decor and different front materials.
